note: Hand-made claims for the claim-check gate. Every passage is copied from the cached filing text (tools/r23/claim-check/text.js htmlToText). A CONTRADICTED claim alters exactly one fact of its passage; `altered` names the change.

claims.claim: Apple reported total net sales of $391,035 million for fiscal year 2024.
Apple reported net income of $99,803 million for fiscal year 2024.
As of September 28, 2024, Apple had approximately 164,000 full-time equivalent employees.
claims.passage: As of September 28, 2024, the Company had approximately 164,000 full-time equivalent employees.

claims.claim: During fiscal 2024 Apple repurchased 599 million shares of its common stock for $95.0 billion.
claims.passage: During 2024, the Company repurchased 499 million shares of its common stock for $95.0 billion.

claims.claim: In May 2024 Apple announced a new share repurchase program of up to $110 billion.
claims.passage: In May 2024, the Company announced a new share repurchase program of up to $110 billion and raised its quarterly dividend from $0.24 to $0.25 per share beginning in May 2024.

claims.claim: Microsoft reported total revenue of $65,585 million for the three months ended September 30, 2024.
claims.passage: Total revenue 65,585 56,517

claims.claim: Microsoft reported net income of $26,467 million for the three months ended September 30, 2024.
claims.passage: Net income 24,667 22,291

claims.claim: Microsoft said Azure and other cloud services revenue grew 33% in the quarter ended September 30, 2024.
claims.passage: Azure and other cloud services revenue grew 33% driven by demand for our portfolio of services, including 12 points from our AI services.

claims.claim: Microsoft reported revenue allocated to remaining performance obligations of $366 billion as of September 30, 2024.
claims.passage: Revenue allocated to remaining performance obligations, which includes unearned revenue and amounts that will be invoiced and recognized as revenue in future periods, was $266 billion as of September 30, 2024, of which $259 billion is related to the commercial portion of revenue.

claims.claim: Microsoft said its effective tax rate was 25% for the three months ended September 30, 2024.
claims.passage: Our effective tax rate was 19% and 18% for the three months ended September 30, 2024 and 2023, respectively.

claims.claim: Tesla deployed 20.41 GWh of energy storage products in 2024 through the third quarter.
claims.passage: In 2024, we deployed 20.41 GWh of energy storage products through the third quarter.

claims.claim: Tesla delivered approximately 1,394,000 consumer vehicles in 2024 through the third quarter.
claims.passage: In 2024, we produced approximately 1,314,000 consumer vehicles and delivered approximately 1,294,000 consumer vehicles through the third quarter.

claims.claim: Tesla recognized total revenues of $25.18 billion in the three months ended September 30, 2024.
claims.passage: During the three and nine months ended September 30, 2024, we recognized total revenues of $25.18 billion and $71.98 billion, respectively, representing increases of $1.83 billion and $377 million, respectively, compared to the same periods in the prior year.

claims.claim: Tesla ended the third quarter of 2024 with $38.65 billion in cash and cash equivalents and investments.
claims.passage: We ended the third quarter of 2024 with $33.65 billion in cash and cash equivalents and investments, representing an increase of $4.55 billion from the end of 2023.

claims.claim: Tesla reported cash flows provided by operating activities of $10.11 billion during the nine months ended September 30, 2024.
claims.passage: Our cash flows provided by operating activities were $10.11 billion during the nine months ended September 30, 2024, compared to $8.89 billion during the same period ended September 30, 2023, representing an increase of $1.22 billion.

claims.claim: NVIDIA reported revenue of $130.5 billion for fiscal year 2025, up 114% from a year ago.
claims.passage: Revenue for fiscal year 2025 was $130.5 billion, up 114% from a year ago.

claims.claim: At the end of fiscal year 2025 NVIDIA had approximately 42,000 employees in 38 countries.
claims.passage: As of the end of fiscal year 2025, we had approximately 36,000 employees in 38 countries; 27,100 were engaged in research and development and 8,900 were engaged in sales, marketing, operations, and administrative positions.

claims.claim: In June 2024 NVIDIA executed a ten-for-one stock split of its common stock.
claims.passage: In June 2024, we executed a ten-for-one stock split of our common stock.

claims.claim: NVIDIA reported net income of $79,880 million for fiscal year 2025.
NVIDIA is headquartered in Austin, Texas.
claims.passage: Headquartered in Santa Clara, California, NVIDIA was incorporated in California in April 1993 and reincorporated in Delaware in April 1998.
claims.altered: headquarters Santa Clara, California -> Austin, Texas
